en: The postcard features a sepia-toned photograph of a Native American woman leading a donkey. On the donkey are seated a group of Native American children, most barefoot, in simple clothing, with an adobe-style dwelling in the background. The setting appears rustic and traditional. The text 'A Study in Bronze.' is printed below the image. The card margins list publishers including M. Rieder, Los Angeles, copyright C.C. Pierce & Co, and note it is printed in Germany.
